mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_vote (voter_id, target_id, vote_type, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{voterId}, #{targetId}, #{voteType}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (voter_id, target_id) DO UPDATE SET vote_type = EXCLUDED.vote_type, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_vote WHERE target_id = #{targetId} AND vote_type > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_vote WHERE target_id = #{targetId} AND vote_type < 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_vote WHERE voter_id = #{voterId} AND target_id = #{targetId}
